headline: About Phireworx
sub: Phoenix-based sports photography team serving high school programs and youth leagues since 2012.
story: Phireworx Photography was founded in 2012 by Rashad Griffin with a simple mission: give every athlete a photo that makes them feel like a pro. What started as a one-person operation has grown into a full team serving hundreds of programs across the Phoenix metro area.

team.name: Rashad Griffin
team.bio: Rashad founded Phireworx in 2012 and has photographed over 50,000 athletes across the Phoenix metro area.

team.name: Crystal Griffin
team.bio: Crystal manages client relationships, scheduling, and day-of operations to make sure every Photo Day runs smoothly.
